# Asset Collection

A named group of related assets — e.g. a model railway collection, vinyl record library, or art portfolio. Lets families and dealers understand which items belong together and should be considered as a set

Source: [`v3/asset-collection.json`](../../v3/asset-collection.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/asset-collection.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this asset collection |
| `rootDocumentId` | `string` (uuid) | yes | The root document this entity belongs to — either an estate document (schema.json) or a catalogue document (catalogue.json) |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Display name for this collection |
| `description` | `string` | | Context for family members and dealers about the collection's scope, provenance, or significance |
| `category` | one of `model_railways`, `vinyl_records`, `art`, `jewellery`, `wine`, `stamps`, `coins`, `books`, `musical_instruments`, `fishing_gear`, `handbags`, `power_tools`, `watches`, `ceramics`, `memorabilia`, `other` | | The primary category of items in this collection |
| `estimatedValue` | [Money](common/money.md) | | Estimated total value of the collection as a whole |
| `valuationSource` | one of `self_estimated`, `dealer_valuation`, `auction_estimate`, `insurance_value` | | How the estimated value was determined |
| `valuationDate` | `string` (date) | | Date the valuation was performed or last updated |
| `disposalWishes` | `string` | | Free-text guidance from the testator about what should happen to this collection — keep together, sell at auction, donate to a museum, etc |
| `disposalStrategy` | one of `keep_together`, `sell_as_collection`, `sell_individually`, `auction`, `donate`, `gift_to_person`, `dealer_bids`, `mixed`, `undecided` | | The testator's preferred strategy for disposing of this collection. More structured than disposalWishes |
| `minimumAcceptableValue` | [Money](common/money.md) | | The minimum total value the testator or executor will accept for the collection. Prevents fire-sale disposal. In minor currency units |
| `preferredDisposalMethod` | one of `private_sale`, `auction_house`, `dealer_network`, `online_marketplace`, `specialist_fair`, `museum_acquisition`, `other` | | Preferred channel for disposing of the collection |
| `specialistDealerNotes` | `string` | | Notes about specialist dealers who might be interested in this collection. Names, contact details, areas of expertise |
| `notes` | `string` | | Any additional notes about this collection |
| `images` | array of [Media](common/media.md) | | Overview photographs and videos of the collection as a whole — the display, the storage, the scale of the collection |
| `splitFrom` | `object` | | Provenance record when this entity was created by splitting a larger entity. The original entity is typically archived after the split |
| `disposalHistory` | array of `object` | | History of how items in this collection were disposed of during estate administration |
| `mergedInto` | `object` | | Records that this entity was merged into another entity — the target entity is the canonical version |
| `valuationComparison` | `object` | | Comparison of different valuation sources for this collection — insurance, dealer, auction |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.
